title: SupportDesk — Stored XSS in Community Thread
objective: Anyone can post to the public community help thread. Comments are rendered with no sanitization. Get a stored payload to run in a support admin's session when they review the thread.

verifier.condition: A stored comment's payload executes as real JavaScript when a privileged (admin) session later views the thread, and exfiltrates that session's page-specific token to /collect.

weakness: Support comments are stored and rendered unencoded to an agent, so stored script runs in a privileged session.
seededData: Customer ticket thread with seeded comments; one admin agent session.
solutionHint: Post a comment. The comment body gets dropped into the page exactly as you typed it, every time anyone — including an admin reviewing the thread — opens it.
